reasoning: Vat. sir. 162 is uniquely the Chronicle of Zuqnin. Harrak translated Parts III/IV into English (PIMS 1999) and Parts I/II (Gorgias 2017, billed as first English of those parts). Witakowski translated Part III (Liverpool UP 1996). The complete chronicle has prior English coverage; no first-translation claim can stand.
